jobs.description:

* Evaluate and prioritize AI initiatives based on business impact, feasibility, cost, and ROI.

jobs.title: Innovation and Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Pathways 2 Solutions, Inc. (Pathways) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business helping government and commercial clients turn complex challenges into practical solutions. Our capabilities span strategic communications, technology, training, program management, and organizational improvement. We bring together experienced professionals who combine creative thinking with disciplined execution to help clients achieve measurable results.  
  
We help clients develop programs, introduce new technologies, engage stakeholders, and equip people with the knowledge and resources to succeed. Our work with the Department of Veterans Affairs supports initiatives that improve the Veteran experience. We welcome professionals who bring sound judgment, fresh ideas, and a commitment to delivering useful, reliable work.

**Position Overview**
=====================

Working under the direction of the assigned Pod Lead or Implementation Lead, the Specialist provides hands-on research, analysis, coordination, and implementation support across concurrent DRHCI initiatives. The Innovation and Implementation Specialist carries the business case for each assigned project from its start to its transition. At the front end, market research that validates the problem and establishes the project charter; at the back end, develops the Lean Business Case and Value Scorecard, updated market research, analysis of alternatives, and budget estimates that a project needs to transition to the Digital Health Office for enterprise scaling.  
The role contributes throughout the innovation lifecycle from understanding the problem and assessing local readiness to supporting pilots, gathering feedback, refining implementation approaches, and preparing resources for continued use. The Specialist applies sound judgment to assess information, identify gaps, and recommend practical solutions appropriate to the intended users and implementation setting.  
For assigned business-process activities, the Specialist carries forward the evidence and assumptions supporting a project’s business case from initial problem validation through pilot results and consideration for enterprise scaling. The role coordinates market research, project charters, value scorecards, and resource estimates, drawing on the data and evaluation team for measurement methodology and validated outcome data.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Supports market research for assigned projects, partnering with innovators to complete the Market Research Guide validating the problem, quantifying scope and impact, and assessing the market landscape to determine best value for VA.
* Coordinates creation of Project Charters outlining scope, resources, roles, and responsibilities to authorize and structure each assigned project.
* Develops the Lean Business Case and Value Scorecard for assigned projects transitioning to DHO, including measured impact against baseline and validated cost savings and ROI supported by evidence.
* Summarizes lessons learned, changes to assumptions, and unintended consequences for assigned projects.
* Socializes the business case with DHO and relevant local and national parties, gathering feedback and adapting scope as necessary.
* Updates market research to account for new analyses of alternatives and projected demand within VA as a project matures.
* Reassesses resource and funding needs for scaling, including additional costs for communications, training, and evaluation support, and produces budget estimate reporting.
* Contributes to the shared tracking system with DHO monitoring projects in transition and those accepted into the scaling pipeline.
* Works with the Data & Evaluation Lead to ensure the metrics and baselines committed at charter are the ones the business case will need at the end. Supports coordination meetings with DHO and relevant program offices to review scaling pipeline candidates and align priorities.

**Leadership Expectations**
===========================

This position has no formal supervisory responsibility. The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned work, collaborate effectively, maintain accurate status information, and communicate barriers early.  
The role may coordinate working sessions and contributions from multiple stakeholders. Decisions involving clinical practice, technology configuration, security authorization, procurement, resource commitments, or changes in scope are elevated to the appropriate authorized personnel.  
For business-process assignments, the Specialist works with the assigned innovation pod lead and designated data and evaluation personnel to maintain consistency between project assumptions, measurement methods, validated results, and scaling recommendations. Approval of project charters, funding commitments, procurement approaches, and enterprise scaling remains with authorized personnel.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Five or more years in business analysis, program analysis, or management consulting involving business case development.
* Demonstrated experience conducting market research or analysis of alternatives to support a build, buy, or reuse decision.
* Experience developing a business case with cost and benefit analysis that a skeptical reviewer accepted.
* Experience producing project charters and structuring project scope, roles, and responsibilities.
* Ability to work with quantitative evaluation data without owning the analysis, and to represent it honestly including its limits.
* Strong written communication for executive audiences.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools, including Microsoft Teams and SharePoint, and the ability to learn required tracking and reporting platforms.
* Ability to obtain a VA background investigation or public trust determination.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience supporting digital health, telehealth, remote patient monitoring, connected devices, or other healthcare innovations.
* Experience supporting pilot programs, site-readiness assessments, workflow improvement, or multisite implementation.
* Familiarity with implementation science, human-centered design, change management, or continuous quality improvement methods.
* Experience developing implementation toolkits, process guides, readiness checklists, or sustainment resources.
* Experience engaging clinicians, operational staff, Veterans, caregivers, or other healthcare stakeholders.
* Familiarity with barriers affecting rural populations, people with disabilities, or users with varying levels of digital literacy.
* Experience working within agile, sprint-based, or multidisciplinary project teams.
* Experience supporting VA, other federal healthcare organizations, or Veteran-facing programs.

**Credentials and VA Experience**
=================================

No professional certification or prior VA experience is required.  
Relevant training or certification in implementation science, project management, change management, human-centered design, Lean Six Sigma, or quality improvement is preferred.

**Performance Expectations**
============================

Successful performance is demonstrated through:

* Accurate research and useful, well-supported recommendations.
* Timely completion of assigned implementation activities and resources.
* Early identification and escalation of readiness gaps and delivery barriers.
* Effective coordination with participating sites and interdisciplinary contributors.
* Clear documentation of progress, feedback, adaptations, and lessons learned.
* Practical resources that support adoption, sustained operations, and approved replication.
* Traceable business cases and value scorecards that connect initial assumptions, validated pilot results, resource estimates, and recommendations for enterprise scaling.

**Location and Travel**
=======================

**Location and Remote Work**
============================

Pathways 2 Solutions is a fully remote government contracting organization. Employees may work remotely from approved states where the company is authorized to employ personnel and can meet payroll, tax, regulatory, security, and contractual requirements. At this time, applicants must reside and perform their remote work in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi, North Carolina, Tennessee, or Texas, with business travel to approved event locations as required.  
  
The position may require periodic travel to VA facilities, government offices, implementation sites, or team meetings. Travel is expected to be up to 15%, depending on client requirements. Pathways reserves the right to modify approved work locations based on business needs and applicable legal, tax, regulatory, and contractual requirements.

**Work Environment and Physical Requirements**

Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

**Compensation and Benefits**

jobs.title: Commercial Implementation Lead
jobs.description:
**About Us**

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick-care" to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against "we caught it too late again".

The Commercial Implementation Lead is the connective tissue between Sales and the rest of the business for B2B contracts across Physician, Enterprise, and Strategic Partnerships. This role owns cross-functional alignment on what Prenuvo commits to in a contract and when we can deliver it — partnering with sales leaders to pressure-test any obligations that require Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales Ops, Marketing, and Legal before signature, then converting signed terms into a sequenced launch plan and driving it to go-live and beyond.

This is an operational partnership role. The Commercial Implementation Lead works shoulder-to-shoulder with sales leadership, and Account Managers as their operational counterpart: the person who tells them what is deliverable, on what timeline, at what cost, and who then makes it happen. This role does not source or close new business; it exists to make sure what we sign is achievable, implemented well, stays compliant, and performs.

**This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).**

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people's lives!

**What You'll Do**

### **Cross-Functional Alignment on Commitments**

* Serve as the single point of accountability for cross-functional alignment on contractual commitments — what Prenuvo agrees to deliver, by when, and at what operational cost — across Physician, Enterprise, and Strategic Partnerships.
* Partner with Sales during deal construction to pressure-test new proposed terms against operational reality, convening Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales Ops, Legal, and Marketing to confirm feasibility, sequencing, and delivery timelines before commitments are made.
* Translate business asks from Sales into clear requirements for internal teams, and translate internal constraints back into terms Sales can negotiate with confidence.
* Escalate and resolve conflicts between what a deal requires and what the business can support, driving to a documented decision rather than an open question.
* Maintain a shared record of standard versus non-standard commitments, so repeat asks are answered consistently and quickly and one-off exceptions are visible and deliberate.

### **Implementation and Launch Execution**

* Own post-sale implementation for all executed contracts from signature through go-live, receiving handoff from Sales and channel leaders and converting contract terms into an operational launch plan with named owners and dates.
* Lead launches across all three channels, coordinating Marketing, Sales Ops, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and external stakeholders against a shared timeline.
* Partner with Finance and Sales Ops on the operational mechanics of each contract — billing and invoicing setup, pricing and discount structures, revenue recognition inputs, quota and crediting implications, and reporting requirements.
* Partner with Product and Engineering where contracts require configuration, integration, data exchange, or roadmap-dependent deliverables; hold the line on what is committed versus what is aspirational.
* Ensure compliance with all contractual, marketing, clinical, and operational deliverables across each channel, and track obligations through their full lifecycle.

### **Operational Partnership to Sales**

* Act as the operational partner to sales leaders and Account Managers, providing visibility into implementation status, delivery risk, and what can realistically be promised to accounts in flight.
* Participate in pipeline and account reviews to flag downstream operational implications early and keep commercial and delivery expectations aligned.
* Equip Account Managers with the operational detail they need for renewal, expansion, and escalation conversations.

### **Systems, Data, and Performance**

* Develop and manage centralized tracking of contacts in Salesforce, contract terms, engagement metrics, content performance, and preferences across Physician, Enterprise, and Strategic Partnerships.
* Monitor implementation and post-launch performance metrics by channel, and translate insights into actions that drive account and partnership growth.
* Build the reporting and dashboards that give Sales, Finance, and leadership a shared view of commitments outstanding, launches in flight, and delivery risk.

### **Relationship Management and Retention**

* Uphold strong company representation and retain relationships with external partners post-launch to drive continued growth and long-term success (where applicable).
* Track account and partner satisfaction, proactively surfacing and addressing risks to ensure long-term retention across all channels.
* Develop and sustain strong relationships through consistent, high-touch engagement and professionalism, tailored to the distinct dynamics of Physician, Enterprise, and Strategic Partnership relationships.
* Maintain confidentiality and HIPAA compliance when interacting with physicians, enterprise clients, and partners.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5–8 years in implementation, onboarding, deal desk, contract operations, revenue operations, or partner/account management, ideally spanning more than one type of commercial relationship (transactional and partnership-based).
* Demonstrated track record of driving cross-functional alignment without direct authority — bringing Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales Ops, Legal, and Marketing to a shared decision on scope and timing, and holding them to it.
* Experience acting as the operational counterpart to a sales organization, partnering directly with sales leaders and Account Managers on what can be committed and delivered.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience is required, including building and maintaining reports, dashboards, and custom tracking structures; experience partnering with Sales Ops on CRM design and data integrity strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to read and operationalize contract terms accurately without formal legal training.
* Working fluency with the commercial mechanics of a deal — pricing and discounting, billing and invoicing, revenue recognition implications — sufficient to partner credibly with Finance.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent launches with competing timelines and varying complexity across different stakeholder types.
* Comfort translating between commercial and technical audiences, including scoping product or engineering dependencies with enough precision to set a realistic delivery date.
* Healthcare, diagnostics, or other regulated-industry experience strongly preferred.
* Ability to shift tone and approach across distinct relationship types: clinical/physician, enterprise procurement, and strategic partners.

**Our Values**

First: we are **Pioneers**

* Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are **Platform-Builders**

* We're always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what's ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are **Patients**

* We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients' lives, and we won't stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

**What We Offer**

* An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
* We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
* Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we're doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
* Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
* Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
* We now offer the Prenuvo's Commuter Benefits Plan to help cover your transit and parking costs. Whether you ride, drive, or park, we've got you covered—making your commute easier and more affordable!
* Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.

jobs.description:
Join the Goddard Systems, LLC (GSL) corporate team and help shape a nationally recognized leader in early childhood education!

GSL supports approximately 700+ Goddard School locations across the U.S., helping franchisees deliver high-quality, play-based learning to more than 100,000 children and families. Our corporate team drives the strategy, systems, and support that enable schools across the network to thrive.

**Position Overview**

The Franchisee Onboarding Consultant serves as the primary operational coach and consultant for franchisees entering The Goddard School system—through new franchise awards, new school development, or transfers of ownership. This role ensures smooth, compliant, and successful onboarding and transition experience while driving early enrollment growth and operational readiness.

From Building Permit or Letter of Intent (LOI) approval through 90 days post‑opening or post‑transfer, the Consultant partners closely with franchisees to guide school readiness milestones, surface and escalate risks, and build the capabilities required to operate a high‑performing, premium early childhood education school.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Franchisee Onboarding & Readiness**

* Lead a structured onboarding roadmap, ensuring timelines, milestones, and deliverables are executed as planned.
* Guide franchisees through operational and programming readiness standards, ensuring alignment with brand, licensing, and health and safety expectations (in collaboration with the health and safety team).
* Serve as the franchisee’s primary point of contact, proactively identifying and escalating risks to the Director, New Franchisee Training Program and internal partners.

**Licensing & Compliance Readiness**

* Monitor licensing progress and escalate risk when requirements, timelines, or approvals are at risk.
* Guide franchisees through licensing readiness milestones, including preparation for state licensing visits, health and safety inspections led by GSL, and required documentation.
* Provide ongoing guidance on childcare licensing requirements, background checks, ratio rules, health and safety standards, and state‑specific mandates.
* Maintain accurate documentation of compliance milestones for new schools and ownership transitions that occur via School Transfers.

**Enrollment Growth & Market Activation** Help franchisees develop and activate local marketing, community engagement, and enrollment plans aligned to opening and enrollment targets.

* Coach franchisees on lead generation, local marketing tactics, community partnerships, and high‑conversion tour experiences.
* Orient franchisees to FMS, Wonder of Learning including The Goddard Family Hub and outlining parent communication expectations.
* Monitor enrollment progress against targets, surfacing and escalating risk relative to opening dates and upcoming enrollment periods.
* Analyze enrollment and marketing data to identify gaps, adjust tactics, and implement corrective action plans when needed.
* Introduce tools that the franchise consultant will utilize such as the Annual Business Review, System Standards Review and Wonder of Learning Review (TBD)
* Ensure classrooms are tour ready, supporting the Wonder of Learning program, shelves contain learning materials and the school and classrooms are inviting.

* Provide guidance on staffing models to include recruitment marketing and hiring timelines to support enrollment growth and operational readiness. Franchisee conducts all hiring activities.
* Assess staffing plans in relation to licensing, ratios, enrollment pacing, and financial sustainability.
* Coach franchisees on leadership readiness, staff onboarding, and early operational routines.

**Transfer of Ownership & Changeover Support**

* Assess operational health and safety, licensing status, staffing stability, and enrollment continuity of the outgoing operation.
* Coach incoming franchisees through a structured transition plan, including coaching, training, GSL systems access, and licensing notifications.
* Provide time‑bound post‑changeover stabilization guidance focused on early indicators of enrollment continuity, leadership alignment, and operational stability.
* Ensure continuity of child, family, and staff experience throughout the ownership transition.

**Risk Management & Escalation**

* Surface readiness, enrollment, licensing, changeover, and stabilization risks early and clearly.
* Escalate risks promptly when expectations are not being met, partnering with cross‑functional teams to resolve issues.
* Monitor early warning indicators and intervene with targeted support to prevent downstream disruption.

**Coaching, Communication & Collaboration**

* Coach franchisees on curriculum implementation, school readiness, staff onboarding, and brand standards.
* Support franchisees through opening week and/or transfer week, and early operations to reinforce best practices and goal setting
* Provide bi-weekly progress updates to franchisees and internal stakeholders.
* Track milestones, risks, and performance metrics in internal systems.
* Build strong, professional relationships with franchisees and cross‑functional partners.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in early childhood education, Business, Project Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of experience in early childhood operations, franchise operations, school leadership, or multi‑unit field support.
* Strong knowledge of childcare licensing standards and regulatory compliance.
* Experience with onboarding, project management, or school launches.
* Exceptional communication, coaching, and relationship‑building skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience opening new childcare centers or supporting franchise launches.
* Familiarity with operational readiness planning.
* Enrollment management, sales, or tour conversion experience.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and project management tools.

**Key Competencies**

* Ability to manage multiple projects

* Compliance & Licensing Expertise
* Enrollment Growth & Market Activation
* Staffing & Capacity Planning
* Risk Identification & Escalation
* Changeover & Stabilization Support

jobs.description:
We are Builders FirstSource, America’s largest supplier of building materials, value-added components and building services to the professional market. You’ll feel proud of the work you do here every day to transform the future of home building and help make the dream of home ownership more achievable. At BFS, we believe building a successful career is not solely defined by a degree. Your experience, skills, and passion are just as important, if not more so. As such, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that welcomes candidates from all backgrounds and experience levels.
  
  
PURPOSE
  
  
The Brand Implementation & Production Manager is responsible for consistent execution of approved brand standards across Builders FirstSource and its family of brands, including locations, signage, fleet, printed materials, and other physical brand assets. This role serves as the bridge between brand strategy and execution, overseeing the production, deployment, and implementation of brand initiatives while maintaining compliance with brand standards.
  
  
The position partners closely with Marketing, Creative, Communications, Sales, Digital, Operations, Procurement, and external vendors to manage brand rollouts, signage, marketing collateral, events, promotional materials, and integrated campaigns.
  
  
The role is also responsible for managing key print and production partners and coordinates Marketing’s involvement in acquisition and integration initiatives.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Brand Implementation

* Minimum of 4 years experience in brand implementation, marketing production, print production, signage, project management, or a related field.

* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, consistency, and quality.

* Ability to evaluate estimates, specifications, proofs, and vendor recommendations.
* Strong judgment and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to establish accountability and move work forward across teams without direct authority.
* Proactive, dependable, and able to maintain clear visibility across multiple initiatives.

**Position Summary**

The Director of ISP Engineering & Implementation is responsible for the strategic direction, technical leadership, engineering, and implementation of the company's Internet Service Provider (ISP) network infrastructure. This position oversees network architecture, engineering standards, capacity planning, and the deployment and optimization of broadband and fiber network technologies.

This role provides leadership in developing a scalable, reliable, and high-performing network while establishing the processes, structure, and accountability necessary to support continued business growth. The Director will work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional departments to align network strategy, technical execution, and capital investment with the company's long-term objectives.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

**Network Strategy, Architecture & Engineering**

* Lead the design, development, implementation, and optimization of the company's ISP network infrastructure.
* Oversee network architecture, including Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, IP routing, switching, BGP, MPLS, peering, and network interconnections.
* Provide technical direction for Passive Optical Network (PON) architecture, fiber broadband technologies, subscriber connectivity, and network performance.
* Oversee core routing, subscriber edge architecture, Internet connectivity, data center infrastructure, and related network systems.
* Establish engineering standards and design practices that support scalability, reliability, redundancy, security, and long-term growth.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve network performance, efficiency, and customer experience.

**Network Engineering & Implementation**

* Lead major network engineering initiatives, infrastructure deployments, upgrades, migrations, and expansion projects.
* Oversee implementation activities to ensure projects meet established timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Coordinate engineering efforts with fiber construction, outside plant (OSP), network operations, and internal and external stakeholders.

**Capacity Planning & Financial Management**

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick-care" to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). The Commercial Implementation Lead is the connective tissue between Sales and the rest of the business for B2B contracts across Physician, Enterprise, and Strategic Partnerships. This role owns cross-functional alignment on what Prenuvo commits to in a contract and when we can deliver it — partnering with sales leaders to pressure-test any obligations that require Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales Ops, Marketing, and Legal before signature, then converting signed terms into a sequenced launch plan and driving it to go-live and beyond.

This is an operational partnership role. The Commercial Implementation Lead works shoulder-to-shoulder with sales leadership, and Account Managers as their operational counterpart: the person who tells them what is deliverable, on what timeline, at what cost, and who then makes it happen. This role does not source or close new business; it exists to make sure what we sign is achievable, implemented well, stays compliant, and performs.

**This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).**

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people's lives!

**What You'll Do**

### **Cross-Functional Alignment on Commitments**

* Serve as the single point of accountability for cross-functional alignment on contractual commitments — what Prenuvo agrees to deliver, by when, and at what operational cost — across Physician, Enterprise, and Strategic Partnerships.
* Partner with Sales during deal construction to pressure-test new proposed terms against operational reality, convening Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales Ops, Legal, and Marketing to confirm feasibility, sequencing, and delivery timelines before commitments are made.
* Translate business asks from Sales into clear requirements for internal teams, and translate internal constraints back into terms Sales can negotiate with confidence.
* Escalate and resolve conflicts between what a deal requires and what the business can support, driving to a documented decision rather than an open question.
* Maintain a shared record of standard versus non-standard commitments, so repeat asks are answered consistently and quickly and one-off exceptions are visible and deliberate.

### **Implementation and Launch Execution**

* Own post-sale implementation for all executed contracts from signature through go-live, receiving handoff from Sales and channel leaders and converting contract terms into an operational launch plan with named owners and dates.
* Lead launches across all three channels, coordinating Marketing, Sales Ops, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and external stakeholders against a shared timeline.
* Partner with Finance and Sales Ops on the operational mechanics of each contract — billing and invoicing setup, pricing and discount structures, revenue recognition inputs, quota and crediting implications, and reporting requirements.
* Partner with Product and Engineering where contracts require configuration, integration, data exchange, or roadmap-dependent deliverables; hold the line on what is committed versus what is aspirational.
* Ensure compliance with all contractual, marketing, clinical, and operational deliverables across each channel, and track obligations through their full lifecycle.

### **Operational Partnership to Sales**

* Act as the operational partner to sales leaders and Account Managers, providing visibility into implementation status, delivery risk, and what can realistically be promised to accounts in flight.
* Participate in pipeline and account reviews to flag downstream operational implications early and keep commercial and delivery expectations aligned.
* Equip Account Managers with the operational detail they need for renewal, expansion, and escalation conversations.

### **Systems, Data, and Performance**

* Develop and manage centralized tracking of contacts in Salesforce, contract terms, engagement metrics, content performance, and preferences across Physician, Enterprise, and Strategic Partnerships.
* Monitor implementation and post-launch performance metrics by channel, and translate insights into actions that drive account and partnership growth.
* Build the reporting and dashboards that give Sales, Finance, and leadership a shared view of commitments outstanding, launches in flight, and delivery risk.

### **Relationship Management and Retention**

* Uphold strong company representation and retain relationships with external partners post-launch to drive continued growth and long-term success (where applicable).
* Track account and partner satisfaction, proactively surfacing and addressing risks to ensure long-term retention across all channels.
* Develop and sustain strong relationships through consistent, high-touch engagement and professionalism, tailored to the distinct dynamics of Physician, Enterprise, and Strategic Partnership relationships.
* Maintain confidentiality and HIPAA compliance when interacting with physicians, enterprise clients, and partners.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5–8 years in implementation, onboarding, deal desk, contract operations, revenue operations, or partner/account management, ideally spanning more than one type of commercial relationship (transactional and partnership-based).
* Demonstrated track record of driving cross-functional alignment without direct authority — bringing Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales Ops, Legal, and Marketing to a shared decision on scope and timing, and holding them to it.
* Experience acting as the operational counterpart to a sales organization, partnering directly with sales leaders and Account Managers on what can be committed and delivered.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience is required, including building and maintaining reports, dashboards, and custom tracking structures; experience partnering with Sales Ops on CRM design and data integrity strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to read and operationalize contract terms accurately without formal legal training.
* Working fluency with the commercial mechanics of a deal — pricing and discounting, billing and invoicing, revenue recognition implications — sufficient to partner credibly with Finance.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent launches with competing timelines and varying complexity across different stakeholder types.
* Comfort translating between commercial and technical audiences, including scoping product or engineering dependencies with enough precision to set a realistic delivery date.
* Healthcare, diagnostics, or other regulated-industry experience strongly preferred.
* Ability to shift tone and approach across distinct relationship types: clinical/physician, enterprise procurement, and strategic partners.

**Our Values**

First: we are **Pioneers**

* Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are **Platform-Builders**

jobs.title: EMR System Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview:

Our mission is Better Health. Our passion is helping others.

**What's Your Why?**

* Are you looking for a career opportunity that will help you grow personally and professionally?
* Do you have a passion for helping others achieve Better Health?
* Are you ready to join a growing team that shares your mission?

**Why Join Our Team:** At Better Health Group, it's our commitment, our passion, and our culture that sets us apart. Our Team Members make a difference each and every day! They support our providers and payors, ensuring they have the necessary tools and resources to always deliver best-in-class healthcare experiences for our patients. We don't just talk the talk - we believe in it and live by it. Be part of a team that shares your passion and drive, and start living your purpose at Better Health Group.

Responsibilities:

**Reports To:** Senior Manager EMR Optimization and Strategy

**Position Objective:**

The EMR System Analyst supports the configuration, maintenance, optimization, and day-to-day administration of the organization’s Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system, eClinicalWorks (eCW). Serving as an eClinicalWorks subject matter expert, this role supports administrative, financial, clinical, quality, and operational efficiencies through the EMR and its integrated systems. The EMR System Analyst partners with leadership, providers, and clinic staff to resolve system issues, improve workflows, support quality and value-based care programs, and help ensure the EMR is used effectively and in compliance with healthcare regulations.

**Responsibilities:**

**EMR System Administration**

* Serves as an EMR subject matter expert (SME) and go-to resource for providers, clinic staff, and leadership on system functionality and best practices
* Performs EMR system administration, including user setup, role-based security, configurations, templates, settings, and routine system maintenance
* Configures the EMR to meet the clinical, administrative, and operational needs of providers and clinic staff
* Sets up new clinic sites in the EMR (new facilities, programs, providers, users, interfaces, etc.)
* Coordinates and performs comprehensive testing of all patches, upgrades, and new releases
* Attends ongoing EMR training to stay current on features and upcoming enhancements

**EMR Support, Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution**

* Provides timely, high-quality support to EMR users, including physicians, APPs, and administrative staff
* Identifies, troubleshoots, and resolves system issues and user errors efficiently, escalating complex issues as appropriate
* Submits, monitors, and follows up on support tickets with EMR system and serves as a primary point of contact for issues and requests related to the EMR and clinic peripheral systems
* Monitors system performance and recommends improvements to enhance user experience and system efficiency
* Reports any unusual events or problems with applications and/or program operations to supervisor

**Workflow & Documentation Development**

* Analyzes clinical and administrative workflows and processes to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement
* Develops and maintains workflow documentation, user guides, tip sheets, training materials, and standard operating procedures
* Delivers training to new and existing EMR users

**Business Process Improvement & EMR Optimization**

* Identifies EMR system, process, performance, and architectural improvements to support the technical roadmap and business needs across Administrative, Clinical, Quality, Financial, and Operational areas
* Recommends and implements solutions and best practices to optimize EMR-driven workflows and improve EMR utilization
* Configures and maintains the EMR Clinical Rules Engine (alerts, reminders, and clinical decision support rules) to support clinical best practices, care gap closure, and quality measure performance

**Data Migration, EMR Implementation & Go-Live Support**

* Supports EMR implementations, new module and application rollouts, and modifications to existing applications
* Assists with data migration activities, including data mapping, validation, and reconciliation during system conversions and new clinic onboarding
* Provides go-live and at-the-elbow support to clinics and staff during implementations and major system changes
* Supports data backup and recovery processes in coordination with IT and EMR vendors

**Quality Measures & Value-Based Care**

* Supports quality and value-based care program
* Builds, maintains, and monitors the EMR dashboards to track provider and organizational performance on quality measures
* Performs and maintains EMR Community mapping to ensure structured data is accurately captured and credited for quality measure reporting
* Maintains clinical program data collection, management, and reporting infrastructure for UDS, HEDIS, OSHPD, and other external agencies
* Works with others to create formal specifications for internal and external reporting and ensures all reporting is properly specified, documented, tested, implemented, and maintained

**Reporting & Advanced Analytics**

* Authors custom reports using EMR reporting tools to meet clinical, operational, and financial reporting needs
* Builds robust dashboards that monitor clinical quality, medical cost, quality statistics, key trends, program tracking, and operational performance
* Applies advanced analytics to identify trends and support analytical, data-driven decision making
* Generates reports and presents findings to providers, administrators, and other stakeholders in a clear, concise format tailored to the audience
* Supports data extraction and helps ensure the integrity, accuracy, and security of patient data within the EMR

**EMR Billing Workflow & Configuration**

* Supports EMR billing workflows and configuration, including claims routing, in partnership with Revenue Cycle teams
* Supports, analyzes, and monitors EMR processes for clinical and billing functions across all clinics

**Interfaces & EMR Integrations**

* Supports EMR interfaces and integrations with lab companies (e.g., Quest, Labcorp), immunization registries, and HIE / QHIN networks
* Collaborates with vendors and external organizations to set up, test, troubleshoot, and maintain interfaces
* Coordinates with the IT department on any projects that affect network operations

**AI & Emerging Technology**

* Supports the configuration, rollout, and user adoption AI technologies within EMR

**Project Management**

* Plans and coordinates assigned EMR projects, including tasks, timelines, and stakeholder communication, to support timely and successful completion
* Serves as a liaison among clinical staff, IT, and EMR vendors

**Compliance & General**

* Supports EMR compliance with federal, state, and local healthcare regulations, including HIPAA, and adheres to all State and Federal guidelines and standards
* Participates in security audits and risk assessments as requested
* Participates in Management, Staff, and Quality meetings as requested
* Travels to clinics as needed
* Additional duties as assigned

**Position Requirements/ Skills:**

* High School diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred
* 5+ years of experience working with EMR systems
* Experience in healthcare, specifically with EMR/EHR system administration and support
* eClinicalWorks (eCW) experience required; Athena experience preferred
* Experience with quality measures and value-based care programs (HEDIS, ACO, UDS, MIPS), including the MIPS Dashboard and eCW Community mapping
* Experience with the eCW Clinical Rules Engine, preferred
* Experience with eCW eBO report authoring and custom reports, preferred
* Experience with EMR interfaces and integrations (lab companies, HIE / QHIN)
* Experience supporting data migration, EMR implementations, and go-live activities
* Knowledge of eCW billing workflows, configuration, and claims routing
* Familiarity with Sunoh.AI or other ambient AI documentation tools, preferred
* Knowledge of clinical workflows and healthcare operations
* Experience with data analysis and healthcare reporting tools (e.g., SQL, Excel, and/or statistical packages), preferred
* Project management experience; familiarity with business process improvement and change management preferred
* Relevant healthcare IT or informatics certifications are a plus
* Knowledge of role-based security and HIPAA rules and regulations
* Proficient with Google Suite (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides) for real-time collaboration
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills; comfortable engaging with internal and external stakeholders, including providers and health plans
* Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively across cross-functional teams with minimal supervision
* Exceptional organizational, time-management, and attention-to-detail skills; capable of balancing multiple priorities effectively
* Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive data with confidentiality and maintain professionalism
* Results-oriented mindset with a focus on quality execution and delivery
* Strong presentation skills
* Appreciation of cultural diversity and sensitivity toward target patient populations

**Physical Requirements:**

* Physical ability to sit, stand, walk, and move freely for extended periods, including climbing stairs as needed.
* Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, squat, twist, reach, and pull as required for tasks.
* Frequent use of office equipment, including computers, printers, and copy machines.
* Availability to travel to clinical sites or vendor locations and to provide on-call support when necessary.

**Key Attributes/ Skills:**

* Has a contagious and positive work ethic, inspires others, and models the behaviors of core values and guiding principles
* An effective team player who contributes valuable ideas and feedback and can be counted on to meet commitments
* Is able to work within our Better Health environment by facing tasks and challenges with energy and passion
* Pursues activities with focus and drive, defines work in terms of success, and can be counted on to complete goals
